movies.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
movies.summary: A rebel warrior helps five women escape a desert tyrant in a nonstop chase across the wasteland. The story is built on survival, sacrifice, and clean action movement.

movies.title: John Wick
movies.summary: A retired assassin returns to the underworld after a personal loss. The film mixes grief, revenge, and sleek fight choreography.

movies.title: The Dark Knight
movies.summary: Batman faces the Joker, a criminal who wants to turn Gotham's order into chaos. The story explores justice, fear, and moral pressure.

movies.title: Inception
movies.summary: A thief who enters dreams is hired to plant an idea inside a target's mind. The mission becomes a maze of memories, guilt, and layered realities.
movies.filming_location: Los Angeles, California and Paris, France

movies.title: Interstellar
movies.summary: A pilot leaves Earth to search for a new home for humanity. The story connects space travel with family, time, and sacrifice.

movies.title: Blade Runner 2049
movies.summary: A replicant blade runner discovers a secret that could change the balance between humans and artificial life. The film is slow, atmospheric, and deeply visual.

movies.title: Dune

movies.title: The Matrix
movies.summary: A hacker discovers that reality is a simulated world controlled by machines. He joins a rebellion and learns to bend the rules of the system.

movies.title: Alien

movies.title: Get Out
movies.summary: A young photographer visits his girlfriend's family and notices disturbing behavior. The film turns social discomfort into sharp psychological horror.

movies.title: A Quiet Place
movies.summary: A family survives in silence while creatures hunt by sound. Every small noise becomes a life-or-death risk.

movies.title: Hereditary
movies.summary: A grieving family uncovers terrifying secrets after the death of their grandmother. The horror grows from trauma, family tension, and ritual dread.

movies.title: The Conjuring
movies.summary: Paranormal investigators help a family facing a violent presence in their farmhouse. The film uses classic haunted-house tension and strong atmosphere.

movies.title: It

movies.title: Scream

movies.title: The Babadook
movies.summary: A mother and son are haunted by a strange storybook creature. The horror reflects grief, exhaustion, and emotional isolation.

movies.title: Midsommar

movies.title: The Silence of the Lambs

movies.title: Se7en

movies.title: Shutter Island

movies.title: Gone Girl

movies.title: Prisoners
movies.summary: A father takes desperate action after his daughter disappears. The story asks how far fear and grief can push a person.

movies.title: Knives Out

movies.title: The Hangover
movies.summary: Three friends wake up in Las Vegas with no memory of the previous night and a missing groom. Their search becomes a chain of chaotic surprises.

movies.title: Superbad
movies.summary: Two high school friends try to make one final party unforgettable before graduation. The comedy is loud, awkward, and surprisingly sweet.

movies.title: Bridesmaids
movies.summary: A struggling woman becomes maid of honor while her life keeps falling apart. The film blends friendship, embarrassment, and emotional recovery.
movies.filming_location: Milwaukee, Wisconsin and Los Angeles, California

movies.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
movies.summary: A hotel concierge and his lobby boy become part of a theft, chase, and friendship story. The movie is precise, funny, and storybook-like.

movies.title: Jojo Rabbit

movies.title: Parasite

movies.title: The Shawshank Redemption

movies.title: Forrest Gump

movies.filming_location: Savannah, Georgia and South Carolina, USA

movies.title: The Godfather
movies.summary: The son of a powerful crime family is drawn deeper into the family business. The film studies loyalty, power, and moral transformation.

movies.title: Pulp Fiction

movies.title: Fight Club

movies.title: Joker

movies.filming_location: New York City and Newark, New Jersey, USA

movies.title: Whiplash

movies.filming_location: Boston, Massachusetts and Los Angeles, California

movies.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once

movies.title: Arrival

movies.title: Ex Machina

movies.title: Black Panther

movies.title: Avengers: Endgame

movies.title: Top Gun: Maverick

movies.title: Django Unchained

movies.title: La La Land

movies.title: The Notebook

movies.title: Titanic

movies.title: Before Sunrise
